document: NDP Headed to Majority Government (Global BC / CKNW, 2020-10-23)
note: Final Ipsos poll before the 2020 election. Mixed mode: n=1,502 (1,002 online Ipsos I-Say panel + 500 phone). Shares among decided voters from the detailed tables (Q2/3, 'Base: Decided voters'): https://www.ipsos.com/sites/default/files/ct/news/documents/2020-10/bc_final_election_poll_tables_oct_23.pdf. BCU = BC Liberal Party. AUTRES = 'Some other party'. n = unweighted decided-voter bases. Region labels verbatim: Metro Vancouver, Vancouver Island, Southern Interior/North.
